description: This file contains a PHP class defining an API controller for handling shipping methods associated with sales in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for retrieving available shipping methods and saving selected shipping options, with logic for managing shipping address validation and session state.

classes.name: ShippingMethod
classes.description: Controller class handling AJAX API requests related to shipping methods during the checkout process in OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles retrieval of available shipping methods, checks for shipping address in session, and returns shipping options or errors as JSON.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes and saves the selected shipping method, updates session data, and returns success or error messages as JSON.
